import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_3.csv"
source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_4.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv(source4_path, index_col=0)

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN : [["Source4_82_2", "Source4_82_4"], ["Institution", "Institution"]]
# 2) JOIN : [["Source4_82_0", "Source4_82_1"], ["Institution", "Institution"]]
# 3) JOIN : [["Source4_82_0", "Source4_82_3"], ["Institution", "Institution"]]

# Step 1: Join Source4_82_2 and Source4_82_4 on Institution
df_2_4 = pd.merge(df2, df4, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Step 2: Join Source4_82_0 and Source4_82_1 on Institution
df_0_1 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Step 3: Join the result of step 2 (df_0_1) with Source4_82_3 on Institution
df_0_1_3 = pd.merge(df_0_1, df3, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Now join the two big parts on Institution to combine all data
# Because the final target table requires all columns combined,
# join df_2_4 and df_0_1_3 on Institution
df_final = pd.merge(df_2_4, df_0_1_3, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Rename and select columns to match the target schema:
# Target Schema:
# ['Institution': string,
#  '(Fall 2011)': float,
#  '(Fall 2012)': float,
#  '(Fall 2013)': float,
#  '(Fall 2014)': float,
#  'persist 2014': integer,
#  'persist 2015': integer,
#  'persist 2016': integer,
#  'Cohort 2014': integer,
#  'Cohort 2015': integer,
#  'Cohort 2016': integer]

# From df_final columns:
# - (Fall 2011), (Fall 2012), (Fall 2013), (Fall 2014) come from df2 (Source4_82_2)
# - persist 2014, persist 2015, persist 2016 come from df0, df1, df3:
#   But source0 has 'year 2016' (persist 2016)
#   source1 has 'year 2014' (persist 2014)
#   source3 has 'year 2015' (persist 2015)
# - Cohort 2014, Cohort 2015, Cohort 2016 come from df4 (Source4_82_4)

# Rename persist columns from year columns:
df_final = df_final.rename(columns={
    'year 2014': 'persist 2014',
    'year 2015': 'persist 2015',
    'year 2016': 'persist 2016'
})

# Cohort columns in df4 are float, convert to integer as target schema requires integer
for cohort_col in ['Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']:
    if cohort_col in df_final.columns:
        df_final[cohort_col] = df_final[cohort_col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# persist columns should be integer as well
for persist_col in ['persist 2014', 'persist 2015', 'persist 2016']:
    if persist_col in df_final.columns:
        df_final[persist_col] = df_final[persist_col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Select and reorder columns exactly as target schema
target_columns = [
    'Institution',
    '(Fall 2011)',
    '(Fall 2012)',
    '(Fall 2013)',
    '(Fall 2014)',
    'persist 2014',
    'persist 2015',
    'persist 2016',
    'Cohort 2014',
    'Cohort 2015',
    'Cohort 2016'
]

# Some (Fall xxxx) columns might be missing if no matching rows, fill missing columns with NaN
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df_final.columns:
        df_final[col] = pd.NA

df_target = df_final[target_columns]

# Ensure float columns are float dtype, integer columns are int dtype
float_cols = ['(Fall 2011)', '(Fall 2012)', '(Fall 2013)', '(Fall 2014)']
int_cols = ['persist 2014', 'persist 2015', 'persist 2016', 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']

for col in float_cols:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

for col in int_cols:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Save the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source4_82_2 and Source4_82_4 on Institution
df_2_4 = pd.merge(source2, source4, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Join Source4_82_0 and Source4_82_1 on Institution
df_0_1 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Join df_0_1 and Source4_82_3 on Institution
df_0_1_3 = pd.merge(df_0_1, source3, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Join df_2_4 and df_0_1_3 on Institution
df_all = pd.merge(df_2_4, df_0_1_3, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Rename columns to match target schema for persist columns (from year columns)
# The persist columns correspond to year 2014, 2015, 2016 from source0, source3, source1
# But source0 has year 2016, source1 has year 2014, source3 has year 2015
# So persist 2014 = year 2014 (source1)
# persist 2015 = year 2015 (source3)
# persist 2016 = year 2016 (source0)
df_all = df_all.rename(columns={
    "year 2014": "persist 2014",
    "year 2015": "persist 2015",
    "year 2016": "persist 2016"
})

# The Cohort columns are already named correctly in source4 and preserved in df_2_4

# Group by Institution and sum the integer columns to ensure uniqueness and correct aggregation
# The float columns are (Fall 2011), (Fall 2012), (Fall 2013), (Fall 2014)
# The integer columns to sum are persist 2014, persist 2015, persist 2016, Cohort 2014, Cohort 2015, Cohort 2016

grouped = df_all.groupby("Institution", as_index=False).agg({
    "(Fall 2011)": "first",
    "(Fall 2012)": "first",
    "(Fall 2013)": "first",
    "(Fall 2014)": "first",
    "persist 2014": "sum",
    "persist 2015": "sum",
    "persist 2016": "sum",
    "Cohort 2014": "sum",
    "Cohort 2015": "sum",
    "Cohort 2016": "sum"
})

# Ensure integer columns are int type (cast after sum)
int_cols = ["persist 2014", "persist 2015", "persist 2016", "Cohort 2014", "Cohort 2015", "Cohort 2016"]
grouped[int_cols] = grouped[int_cols].astype(int)

# Write output to the target file
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
